# FilterChip

A chip that filters a list (All, Self-care, Feelings…), or an icon chip that shows or hides a part of the page (the info chip).

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- In the tone of what it filters (Self-care purple, Feelings teal, Home practice sun).
- Off: paper with the tone's line and ink. On: the tone's ink as the fill with white words, no tick: the light-to-dark change shows it (at least 3:1 against paper), so it never relies on hue.
- An icon-only chip (info) carries a spoken label; a 44px target; announced as selected or on.

Tokens: `component.chip` (fill, ink, line, line-hover, fill-on-ground, outline-fill, live, live-ink, fill-selected, ink-selected) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website has nothing to filter. |
| Design System | `.fmt-chip.is-filter`, `<FilterChip>` |
| App | `FmtFilterChip` |
